scope.defined_running_fault: BMS main and old 12 V/CORE/CAN withdrawn; downstream BUS positive and return conductors retained. The independent supply remains connected.
scope.supply_input_loss_recovery: BUS falls then rises through 14 V; measure all source, reference and supervisor startup time.
scope.cold_high_bus_start: Hard READY handshake must prevent traction and commanded regen until the independent chain is ready. A cold 37.8 V source plus immediate 450 W injection has insufficient startup energy margin.
scope.excluded_additional_fault: Independent regulator forced to zero with BUS still healthy is a separate internal supply fault. No 3 m stopping credit is assigned to it.
scope.vehicle_stop_qualification: HOLD; neither this calculation nor the reset timer proves motor torque or a 3 m stop.

selected_parts.reference: REF5025ID, high grade; AI standard grade is not an equivalent
selected_parts.ctr: 2.2 nF C0G, total effective 1.98–2.42 nF on CTR/MR pin 9; CTS pin 10 unpopulated
selected_parts.feedforward: 2.2 nF C0G, same SKU as CTR; minimum 1.98 nF > 1.592 nF required by the LT3010 application condition
selected_parts.rail_slew: Two FH RAG-06K22R0FT, 22 ohm 1% 0.5 W, in series; >=10 uF effective at the common driver/supervisor node
selected_parts.hard_ready: Reuse the existing GUARD-driven READY LED sink, with a series BC847C enabled by HW_READY through 10k and a 100k base pull-down. HW_READY pull-up is 4.7k, external pull-down 100k.
selected_parts.analogue_hold: Diode and >=10 uF effective supply both REF5025 and TLV1811
selected_parts.resistor_temperature: Source feedback and POR divider <=25 ppm/C, body 0..85 C; slew resistance budget <=200 ppm/C. Initial tolerance and drift are added, not conflated.

rail.slew_resistor_scope: Peak-voltage comparison only against the vendor five-second short-overload test condition. Full high-capacitance startup current, pulse duration/energy, hot-board behavior and repeated starts remain qualifications; the LT3010 50 mA rating is not a peak-current upper bound.
rail.ready_load_note: High-level loading and measured READY must meet the UCC input threshold, without treating its typical internal pull-down as a guarantee.

source_thermal.scope: DC sizing only. The exposed pad must be soldered to GND copper. Actual PCB thermal resistance, source pulse/short behavior, input peaks and capacitor charging remain qualifications; the 62 C/W copper reference is not a finished-board guarantee.

timing.hold_scope: Requires verified diode drop/leakage, effective capacitance, load and recharge. For repeated glitches, measure the held node minimum and enforce the qualified waveform envelope.
timing.reference_establishment: Measure REF within 2.49725–2.50275 V before every READY rise, across zero/residual initial charge, actual load and 0–60 C ambient with component self-heating included.

energy_recovery.scope: Power, effective BUS capacitance and response bounds must be replaced by qualified system corners. Recovery does not establish vehicle stopping capability.

maximum_capacitance_startup.pre_ready_load_reason: The 16 mA running budget includes 6 mA gate charge at 300 nC and 20 kHz. RESET holds IN+ low before READY, so only the other full 10 mA is allocated during charging. Reference output charging is additionally budgeted as charge, not hidden in DC current.
maximum_capacitance_startup.scope: Conditional charge bound with zero initial charge, initial tolerance +20%, X7R temperature +15%, and pre-READY 10 mA load. Source turn-on <=2 ms and >=50 mA available charging current are qualification conditions, not measured or full-startup datasheet guarantees. Full BUS14-to-READY <=50 ms is the governing physical criterion. The old 22 nF timer fails this allocated worst corner; changing to 2.2 nF adds no components.

measurements: Actual REF settling before READY, driver threshold, held analogue supply and reset recovery over the specified cold/residual/brownout waveform envelope.
Source startup: BUS rising through 14 V to valid READY <=50 ms at the stated energy corner; cold BUS step to 22.5 V with concurrent injection separately.
Old-rail loss: new source and return remain functional, without unintended backfeed or a new reset during the defined main fault.
Qualified independent chain: threshold to branch current matching net regen <=0.5 ms, near-bridge voltage and release current/energy within approved bounds.
